prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Wide overhead still life of five matte six-sided hexagon seat tokens in a ring, each with a different plain embossed shape, linked by thin steel rods to a larger deep blue six-sided hexagon at the centre. Subject spread along the horizontal centre line with wide quiet margins left and right. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: the rim of the central hexagon, in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
